title: Apply for a bus operator accreditation
summary: You can apply for accreditation as a bus operator online through Transport for NSW.
intro:
You can apply for accreditation as a bus operator, online.

To determine your eligibility and thoroughly assess your application, Transport for NSW (TfNSW) requires specific documentation from you. Ensure you can provide the documentation before you apply.
who_can_apply: Be a person of good repute.
Be financially capable of carrying on a bus service.
Have local council approval for the nominated bus depot.
Successfully complete the Bus Operator Accreditation Scheme- BOAS (on-line) Training Course.
what_you_need: A copy of your Australian driver licence (scanned as a PDF). If you hold an interstate licence or do not hold an Australian driver licence, you need a secondary proof of identity document.
A copy of your Bus Operator Accreditation certificate.
Evidence you've paid the non-refundable application fee.
A National Police check issued no more than 3 months prior to this application.
The Bus Operator Accreditation Package – PDF.
An additional statement from a qualified accountant regarding the solvency and general financial standing of the corporation (if applicable).
A signed lease arrangement with the owner of the property showing the address of the depot (if applicable).
A signed statement declaring any bankruptcy, criminal or civil convictions, or charges pending that have occurred within the last 5 years (if applicable).

how_to_steps.text: Check you have all the documents you'll need to upload.
Select the 'Next' button and complete the online application form.
